# Hashed hygiene tokens, enforced by tools/ci/check-public-hygiene.py (run from
# tools/ci/check-public-hygiene.sh). Some blocked vocabulary is itself
# non-public (private host names, private repository slugs, held-back private
# paths), so it must not be spelled out in this public tree. Each line is
#
#   <class> <TAB> <scope> <TAB> <sha256 of the lowercase token> <TAB> <mode>
#
# The checker lowercases and hashes every candidate token found in the tracked
# tree and fails on a hash listed here. Candidate tokens are: hyphen/underscore
# delimited words and runs of up to two of them (so "x-y" matches as a word and
# "x-y-z" still contains it), and runs of up to three consecutive path segments
# joined by "/". scope "all" applies to every tracked text file, scope "md"
# to markdown files only. mode "block" fails the gate; mode "advisory" prints a
# warning only (no rule uses it today; kept for rules awaiting a ruling).
# To add a token:
#   printf '%s' 'token' | tr A-Z a-z | shasum -a 256
# Classes: internal-hosts (private machine names), private-repos (private
# repository slugs; a link to one is a link nobody outside can open),
# build-infra (private build-fleet paths), dangling-tooling (private tooling
# paths that are not in this tree), held-back-docs (private planning and
# test-tracking paths that prose must not send a reader to).
